description: An Expo SDK names one version of each of its native packages. The command `expo install --fix` changes those versions with the SDK, so Renovate gives them only patch updates and security fixes.

packageRules.description: Renovate does not give a major or minor update to a package that the Expo SDK decides. A security fix still comes: a package rule with enabled false stops a security fix too, so this rule leaves it out.
A new Expo SDK shows on the Dependency Dashboard, with no pull request until a person asks. The owner of the repository moves the SDK with `expo install --fix`.
